clue.text: Go wild about traditional clothing business

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second here

parts.note: to go wild is to rage
trad is the short form of traditional, as in trad jazz

explanation.surface: Someone urged to rebel against an old-fashioned fashion trade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Go wild' looks like the anagram signal, but it is a synonym piece; 'about' is the container word.
explanation.definitionFit: The rag trade is the informal name for the garment-making industry.

clue.text: Improvement made by scripture class

parts.note: RE is religious education, the British school subject once called scripture
a form is a school class

explanation.surface: A school claims progress made in its religion lessons.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a class is a form, and scripture lessons are RE.
explanation.definitionFit: A change for the better is an amendment of this kind.

clue.text: Non-Spanish speaker makes attempt to accommodate band

indicators.note: to accommodate means the word for attempt holds the word for band inside it

parts.note: a go is an attempt
a ring is a band, as a wedding band

explanation.surface: A foreigner tries to find room for a musical group.
explanation.definitionFit: In Latin America, the slang word for a foreigner, especially an English-speaking American, who is not a native speaker.

clue.text: Advance fee paid to old servant

explanation.surface: Paying an upfront fee to a long-serving domestic.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a fee paid up front to secure services, and also a faithful household servant of long standing.

clue.text: Discontinue drive to work

explanation.surface: A suggestion to stop the daily commute.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to abandon something, and also to give someone a lift and let them out, as at their office.

clue.text: Piece of garlic Rex used as fodder

parts.note: one segment of a garlic bulb is a clove
R stands for Rex, king, as on coins and in royal signatures

explanation.surface: A king's garlic used as animal feed.
explanation.definitionFit: This plant is grown as forage for cattle and other livestock.

clue.text: A small manoeuvre made by pack-animals

indicators.note: manoeuvre means the letters of a small are moved about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Beasts of burden making a minor shift.
explanation.definitionFit: These South American camelids are kept to carry loads.

clue.text: Winner gets first-class return to Melbourne area

parts.note: a victor is a winner

indicators.note: return means the letters for first-class are written backwards

parts.note: A1 means first-class; read as letters it is AI

explanation.surface: A champion flies back to Melbourne in first class.
explanation.definitionFit: Melbourne is the capital of this Australian state.

clue.text: Banish emissary following note

indicators.note: following places the word for emissary after the note

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a legate is an envoy or emissary

explanation.surface: An envoy is expelled after a diplomatic note.
explanation.definitionFit: To consign someone to a lower place or exile is to send them away.

clue.text: Disharmony it's right to portray in novels

indicators.note: in tells us one letter goes inside the word for novels

parts.note: novels as a class are fiction

explanation.surface: A novelist claims it is proper to depict discord in books.
explanation.definitionFit: Conflict or clashing between people is described as rubbing, a sense of disagreement.

clue.text: Bit of a trouble-maker — a scallywag really

definitions.text: Bit of a trouble-maker — a scallywag really

indicators.note: bit of says only a part of the following words is wanted, a run of their letters

explanation.surface: A remark that a naughty child is something of a nuisance.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across the end of 'trouble-maker' and the start of 'a scallywag'; the whole clue also describes a mischievous person.
explanation.definitionFit: A rogue or scamp, especially a cheeky child, is a mischief-making scallywag.

clue.text: Model clothed in scarlet is refreshed

indicators.note: clothed in means the word for model is wrapped inside the colour

parts.note: scarlet is a shade of red
to pose is to model for an artist

explanation.surface: An artist's model dressed in red feels rested.
explanation.definitionFit: Having rested, one is restored, which is the sense of refreshed.

clue.text: Get back to find Georgia in control

indicators.note: in places the state's abbreviation inside the word for control

parts.note: to rein in is to control, and a rein is the strap that controls a horse
GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia

explanation.surface: Instructions for recovering by putting a US state under management.
explanation.definitionFit: To recover something lost is to get it back.

clue.text: Manage to maintain amicable relations

explanation.surface: Advice on keeping friendly with others.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to cope or make progress and to be on friendly terms with someone.

clue.text: Commission young lady to acquire sword

parts.note: a cut is a share or commission taken from a sale
a lass is a girl or young woman

explanation.surface: A girl is paid to buy a weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: This short curved blade was carried by sailors and pirates.

clue.text: Attack and incriminate old pole

parts.note: to set someone up is to frame or incriminate them
N stands for the north pole

explanation.surface: Assaulting and framing an elderly Polish man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pole' looks like a Polish person but gives N, north, one of the earth's poles.
explanation.definitionFit: To be set upon is to be assaulted, so the phrase is a verb for attacking.

clue.text: Inclination to indulge in mediaeval sport

explanation.surface: A leaning towards jousting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a slope or lean, and also to joust on horseback with a lance.

clue.text: Cleric has a place in housing queue

indicators.note: housing says the word for queue holds a and place inside it

parts.note: a chain is a line or queue of people
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: A priest has a spot in a line for homes.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman attached to a college, hospital or regiment is this kind of minister.

clue.text: Broadcast supporting compensation demand

parts.note: pro means in favour of, supporting
a claim is a demand for compensation, as on insurance

explanation.surface: Publicising backing for a payout.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce publicly is to spread the word, a verb sense of broadcast.

clue.text: Hasten to expose corrupt nepotist

indicators.note: corrupt means the letters of nepotist are spoilt into a new order

explanation.surface: A call to hurry and unmask a crooked official favouring relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is an informal command to press the accelerator, to hurry up.

clue.text: Male deity in Egypt; female one in Greece

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
Ra is the Egyptian sun god

explanation.surface: A comparison of gods: a male one in Egypt, a goddess in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads like two separate definitions, but 'Male' and 'deity in Egypt' are pieces, and only 'female one in Greece' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: She was queen of the Olympian gods, wife of Zeus in Greek mythology.

clue.text: Stencil ordered by regular buyers

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of the word stencil are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Stencils being ordered by a shop's usual customers.
explanation.definitionFit: Customers who buy regularly from a business are its patrons.

clue.text: Reluctant to say that half of Africa needs help

indicators.note: half of takes the first three letters of the six in Africa

parts.note: aid is help

explanation.surface: A grim report that half a continent needs assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: One says 'I'm sorry to say' as a hedge, meaning regretfully unwilling to state it.

clue.text: Change into suit

explanation.surface: Putting on a new outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to turn into something, and also to look good on, as a dress flatters its wearer.

clue.text: Toy weapon placed under bar

indicators.note: placed under puts the weapon below the letter for bar in this down answer

parts.note: T is a bar shape, as in T-bar
a rifle is a firearm

explanation.surface: A toy gun stored beneath the counter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Toy' looks like an adjective for the weapon; it is the verb, to toy with.
explanation.definitionFit: To trifle with something is to play idly with it.

clue.text: Non-belligerent ensures condition is included in treaty

indicators.note: included in places the condition and is inside the word for treaty

parts.note: a treaty is a pact
if introduces a condition
taken as written

explanation.surface: A peace-lover makes sure a clause goes into the agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone opposed to war and violence refuses to fight, so is non-belligerent.

clue.text: Look for a soft fruit

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for soft
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Searching for a ripe piece of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To seem, as in 'you look tired', is a sense of looking.

clue.text: Nothing found in California but fuel

indicators.note: found in places the zero inside the abbreviation for the state

parts.note: O, a zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing turns up in California except fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: This black mineral is burnt as a fuel.

clue.text: A lawyer confined by veto in Iran

indicators.note: confined by says the lawyer is held inside the word for veto

parts.note: a veto is a ban
DA is a district attorney, a US public prosecutor

explanation.surface: A lawyer is barred by a veto while in Iran.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an oil-refining port city in south-western Iran.

clue.text: Blowing one's top and leaving

explanation.surface: Someone losing their temper and storming out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means exploding in anger, and also departing.

clue.text: Mother returns amongst numbers of travellers

indicators.note: amongst places the turned word inside the word for numbers
returns means the word for mother is read backwards

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal

explanation.surface: A mother coming back among a group of wanderers.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords a dam is an animal's mother, not a barrier; 'returns' reverses it before it goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanderers with no fixed home move from place to place.

clue.text: Quite aware there are no absentees

explanation.surface: A teacher's roll-call finding everyone present and alert.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means mentally sharp, and also that everyone is present.
